# teams_emergency_calling_policy (Resource)

Manages the EmergencyCallingPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsEmergencyCallingPolicy / Get-CsTeamsEmergencyCallingPolicy / Set-CsTeamsEmergencyCallingPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsEmergencyCallingPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `enhanced_emergency_service_disclaimer` (String) Maps to the -EnhancedEmergencyServiceDisclaimer parameter.
- `extended_notifications` (String) Maps to the -ExtendedNotifications parameter.
- `external_location_lookup_mode` (String) Maps to the -ExternalLocationLookupMode parameter.
- `notification_dial_out_number` (String) Maps to the -NotificationDialOutNumber parameter.
- `notification_group` (String) Maps to the -NotificationGroup parameter.
- `notification_mode` (String) Maps to the -NotificationMode parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
